newsitem.title: USA: Go-Video launches product in Japan.
newsitem.headline: Go-Video launches product in Japan.

text.p: Go-Video Inc, a maker of dual-deck videocassette recorders, said Tuesday it has begun selling VCRs in Japan and has plans to accelerate its roll-out by almost six months.

"Within the largest worldwide markets, there appears to be strong interest in our products, and we are accelerating international sales plans to capitalize on this demand," Roger Hackett, chief executive officer, said in a statement.
"Royalties from these sales will be relatively small this year, but next year we expect them to be material," he added.
Go-Video is completing development of models designed specifically for Japan, where standards resemble those of the system used in the United States.
The company also has a definitive agreement for sales in the United Kingdom with Dixons Stores and recently concluded a distribution agreement for the European continent.

"The beginning of our sales internationally is another milestone for Go-Video," Hackett said. "We promised our shareholders global expansion, and now not only are we making good on that pledge, but the market potential looks better than we expected."
